SimpleStringSplit.description: Split a string by delimiter, strip whitespace from each part, and drop empty segments.

SimpleNotify.description: Send enabled alerts when execution reaches this node, then pass the input value through unchanged.

value.name: Value
value.tooltip: Value used as the execution dependency and passed through unchanged.

message.name: Message
message.tooltip: Notification text; leave empty to use the localized default.

desktop_notification.name: Desktop notification
desktop_notification.tooltip: Show a desktop notification in the initiating ComfyUI client.

sound.name: Sound
sound.tooltip: Play the bundled alert sound in the initiating ComfyUI client.

ConditionalSaveImage.description: Save images only while enabled; otherwise pass them through unchanged. Uses LoraManager's save implementation when installed, otherwise the core PNG save.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Images to save; always passed through unchanged.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.tooltip: Optionally connect LoraManager's manual metadata override output so its values execute before saving.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.tooltip: When off, nothing is saved and the images pass through unchanged.

filename_prefix.name: Filename Prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Base filename. With LoraManager installed, patterns like %seed% or %date:...% are supported.

file_format.name: File Format
file_format.tooltip: png/jpeg/webp. jpeg and webp require ComfyUI-Lora-Manager.

lossless_webp.name: Lossless WebP
lossless_webp.tooltip: Save WebP losslessly. Larger files; requires ComfyUI-Lora-Manager.

quality.name: Quality
quality.tooltip: Compression quality for JPEG and lossy WebP (1-100).

embed_workflow.name: Embed Workflow
embed_workflow.tooltip: Store the complete workflow in saved images so they can be dragged back into ComfyUI. PNG and WebP only.

save_with_metadata.name: Save With Metadata
save_with_metadata.tooltip: Embed generation parameters into the saved image metadata.

add_loras_to_prompt.name: Add LoRAs To Prompt
add_loras_to_prompt.tooltip: Append the LoRA syntax line after the positive prompt in the saved metadata. Requires ComfyUI-Lora-Manager.

add_counter_to_filename.name: Add Counter To Filename
add_counter_to_filename.tooltip: Append an incremental counter to filenames to avoid overwriting previous images.

save_as_recipe.name: Save As Recipe
save_as_recipe.tooltip: Also save each image as a LoRA Manager recipe. Requires ComfyUI-Lora-Manager.

GroupIsEnabled.description: Report whether the selected visual group is fully disabled at the moment the prompt is queued.

0.name: Disabled
0.tooltip: True when every node in the selected group is muted or bypassed.

GroupLogicProbe.description: Combine multiple visual-group enabled/disabled probes with AND or OR at the moment the prompt is queued, and output one boolean for lazy branching.

0.name: Result
0.tooltip: Combined probe result; connect to a lazy conditional branch such as ImpactConditionalBranch's cond.

PromptSelector.description: Select, order and weight prompt-library entries while keeping an optional prefix input.

prefix_prompt.name: Prefix prompt
prefix_prompt.tooltip: Optional prompt placed before selected entries.

BooruGalleryNode.description: Search supported booru sites and output an ordered image and prompt snapshot.

0.name: Images
0.tooltip: Selected images in the exact saved order.

1.name: Prompts
1.tooltip: Processed prompts paired one-to-one with Images.

ResolutionPreset.description: Choose an exact aligned width and height with presets, direct input, or a draggable canvas.

FetchFromKrita.description: Read the active Krita document and its current selection when this node executes.

0.name: Image
0.tooltip: Visible composite of the active Krita document.

1.name: Mask
1.tooltip: Current Krita selection, or an empty mask when no selection exists.

QuickGroupManager.description: Quickly enable, mute, or bypass visual groups with color scopes, ordering, and linkage rules.
